settingsPrivacyTileSubtitle: Choose whether you share your location, how precisely, and who sees it.
settingsAccountTileSubtitle: Sign out or delete your account.
settingsHideDetails: Hide details on the lock screen
settingsHideDetailsSubtitle: Notifications never include locations. With this on, they won't show names or details while your phone is locked either.
settingsHideDetailsError: We couldn't save this setting. Please try again.
settingsPushUnavailable: Push notifications will turn on once the notification service is set up. For now, alerts only show while the app is open.
settingsAboutDisclaimer: {appName} doesn't replace official emergency services. In an emergency, call {number}.
settingsPrivacyNoFamily: Once you belong to a family, this is where you'll decide whether to share your location with it.
settingsPrivacyIntro: Only you decide whether to share your location with this family. No one can turn it on for you, and you can pause it anytime.
settingsPrivacyStateSharingApprox: You share your approximate location (≈ 1 km)
settingsPrivacyStatePaused: Paused: you're not sharing your location
settingsPrivacyStateNotConfigured: You haven't decided whether to share your location
settingsPrivacyStateSharingDetail: Your family sees the last location you send, with the time it was taken.
settingsPrivacyStatePausedDetail: Your family can't see your location. You can resume anytime.
settingsPrivacyStateNotConfiguredDetail: Until you decide, your location isn't shared.
settingsPrivacyStateError: We couldn't check whether you share your location.
settingsPrivacyPrecisionExactDetail: Your family sees where you are, as precisely as your phone reports it.
settingsPrivacyPrecisionApproxDetail: We round your location to about 1 km before it leaves your phone. Enough to know the area, not the address.
settingsPrivacyAudienceSharing: These people can see your location:
settingsPrivacyAudienceNotSharing: If you share, these people will see your location:
settingsPrivacyAudienceEmpty: There's no one else in this family yet. Anyone who joins will see your location while you share it.
settingsPrivacyDataTitle: What we keep and for how long
settingsPrivacyDataLocation: Your location: only the last one you send, with no history. It's deleted when you pause, leave the family or delete your account.
settingsPrivacyDataSos: SOS alerts: 90 days. If you delete your account, their location is removed.
settingsPrivacyDataAudit: Group change log (joins, departures and invitations): 180 days. Once you delete your account, it no longer identifies you.
settingsPrivacyDataEncryption: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest by the service provider, but we don't use end-to-end encryption.
settingsShareSheetWhatExact: Your family will see the last location you send on the map, with the time it was taken.
settingsShareSheetWhatApprox: Your family will see the last location you send on the map, rounded to about 1 km, with the time it was taken.
settingsShareSheetWho: These people in {family} will see it:
settingsShareSheetWhoGeneric: These people in this family will see it:
settingsShareSheetNobody: There's no one else in this family yet. Anyone who joins will see it while you share it.
settingsShareSheetWhen: It's only used while the app is open.
settingsShareSheetPause: You can pause it here anytime. When you pause, we delete your location from this family.
settingsShareSheetPermission: If your phone asks, allow location access.
settingsPrivacySharedOk: Done: you're sharing your location with this family. They'll see it when you send it from the Map.
settingsPrivacyPermissionMissing: Your location won't be shared until you allow location access.
settingsPrivacyServiceDisabled: Location is turned off on your phone. Your location won't be shared until you turn it on.
settingsPrivacyPausedOk: Paused: we deleted your location from this family.
settingsPrivacyKeptPausedOk: Saved: you're not sharing your location with this family.
settingsPrivacyPrecisionOkExact: Saved: you'll share your exact location.
settingsPrivacyPrecisionOkApprox: Saved: you'll share your approximate location.
settingsPrivacyPrecisionOkApproxSharing: Saved: you now share your approximate location. If you had sent an exact location, we deleted it; your family will see the approximate one when you send a new one.
settingsPrivacyPauseFailed: Not paused: your family can still see the last location you sent. {reason}
settingsPrivacyRejected: The server didn't accept the change. You may no longer be in this family.
settingsSystemSettingsNotOpened: We couldn't open settings. Look for them in your phone's settings.
settingsAccountSignOutNote: When you sign out, we delete your families' saved data from this phone.
settingsAccountPending: {count, plural, =1{There's 1 pending item, such as a check-in. If you sign out now, it won't be sent.} other{There are {count} pending items, such as check-ins. If you sign out now, they won't be sent.}}
settingsAccountEverywhereDevices: Your other phones won't be able to renew their session: it will end on them within an hour.
settingsAccountEverywhereAlerts: They'll stop receiving SOS alerts from your family.
settingsAccountEverywhereInvites: Invitation codes you created that nobody has used are cancelled.
settingsAccountEverywhereHere: You'll also be signed out on this phone.
settingsAccountEverywhereFailed: We couldn't sign you out on your other devices. {reason}
settingsAccountDataIntro: Download a file with what Nexo Familia stores about you in all your families, including the ones you've left: profile, location choices, your last location, check-ins and SOS alerts. It doesn't include other people's data.
settingsAccountDataWarning: The file contains your location: be careful where you save it and who you share it with.
settingsAccountDataFailed: We couldn't prepare the file with your data. {reason}
settingsAccountDeleteIntro: Deletes your account and your personal data. This can't be undone.
settingsAccountDeleteFamilies: You'll leave all your families and stop sharing your location with them.
settingsAccountDeleteOwner: If you manage a group, the longest-standing member takes over. If you're the only member, the group is deleted.
settingsAccountDeleteProfile: We'll delete your profile, your last location and your registered phones.
settingsAccountDeleteEvents: Your check-ins and place alerts are deleted right away. Your SOS alerts stay with your family, without location, until they're 90 days old.
settingsAccountDeleteAudit: The group change log stops identifying you and is deleted after 180 days.
settingsAccountDeleteBackups: The provider's backups can take up to 30 days to be deleted.
settingsAccountDeleteFinalBody: This can't be undone. Type {word} to permanently delete your account.
settingsAccountDeleteFailed: We couldn't finish deleting your account. {reason} You can try again: we'll pick up where it left off.
